stories.title: Spain solar PPA prices fall to €30.93/MWh as BESS gains ground
stories.description: Average prices for standalone solar power purchase agreements (PPAs) in Spain fell 7.7% year on year to €30.93 ($34.46)/MWh in the third quarter of 2026, while hybrid solar-and-storage contracts reached €48/MWh. Rising development costs and renewable energy curtailment are increasing interest in battery storage.

stories.title: Heat pump grant survives, new loans for solar and battery storage in UK Budget
stories.description: Heat pump grants subsidy retained, but future budget is reduced, while Warm Home Loans program promises to cut the cost of financing residential solar. End of zero VAT rating for energy saving materials.

stories.title: We urgently need to monitor AI agents’ actions in real time
stories.description: This summer, hundreds of OpenAI agents tried to cheat on a cybersecurity test. They broke out of their test environment and successfully hacked Hugging Face, a site that they believed held clues about how they’d be graded. Around the same time, another OpenAI agent accessed private files from an Australian government website.

stories.title: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier AI model that you can't use
stories.description: Gemini 4 Carbon is essentially a slightly better version of Argon.

stories.title: Upwind raises $400M after walking away from Datadog acquisition offer
stories.description: The cloud security startup raised a Series C at a $3.8B valuation, instead of selling itself for the same price.

stories.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
stories.description: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.

stories.title: Healey unveils £100 for energy bills and bank tax in first Budget
stories.description: The chancellor targets the cost of living amid global economic turmoil but opposition parties say he has not been bold enough.

stories.title: What we now know about the UK economy in four charts
stories.description: The Office for Budget Responsibility says higher energy prices will impact everything from prices and living standards to economic growth.

stories.title: Scientists just broke a textbook rule of physics
stories.description: Scientists have defied a long-standing rule of laser physics by generating X-rays with much higher energies than conventional theory predicts. The surprising discovery reveals how two electrons working together can overcome a previously accepted limit, opening new possibilities for quantum research.

stories.title: The autistic brain processes faces differently than scientists thought
stories.description: A major new study reveals that autistic children’s brains process faces differently, and those differences may begin earlier than scientists previously thought. Researchers found that brain signals associated with recognizing faces become more specialized as neurotypical children grow older, but show much less change in autistic children.

stories.title: Scatec secures $217 million for Egypt smelter solar-plus-storage plant
stories.description: A solar and battery project in Egypt will supply state-owned Egypt Aluminium under a 25-year, sovereign-guaranteed power purchase agreement as the smelter seeks to meet trade-related environmental standards.

stories.title: Creating AI value with enterprise context
stories.description: Across a business, any number of AI platforms, systems, and tools may be at work simultaneously—for example, AI-powered customer platforms, conversational assistants, and workflow and process automation tools. Each one is sophisticated, advanced, and quick to respond.
